subcommands.description: Run eval cases (<eval dir>/**/case.yaml or prompt.md + graders/*.md; the eval dir is evals/ unless --eval-dir or the manifest says otherwise) against a plugin and report scored results. Target is a path, a plugin name, or a `plugin@marketplace` id — installed and skills-dir plugins both resolve (and add a no-plugin baseline arm). It loads the plugin and runs its eval suite (prompts, graders; scaffold scripts and real MCP servers only when you opt in) on your machine, as you: only evaluate plugins you trust — the run's sandboxing limits what a malicious plugin can reach but is not a guarantee, and a bundled suite passing is not a security vetting. The first run in an untrusted plugin directory asks you to confirm (--trust-plugin answers for CI)
